contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.hint: Shown in the footer of every page, on the order confirmation and in emails to customers. Leave a field empty to hide that channel.

contacts.instagramHint: Your account name (@name) or the link to your profile.

contacts.telegramHint: Your username (@name) or a t.me link.
contacts.viberHint: Your phone number with the country code, or a Viber invite link.
contacts.whatsappHint: Your phone number with the country code, or a wa.me link.

prices.title: Prices in other currencies
prices.hint: You set every price in USD. Visitors see it converted at the NBU rate plus the markup, rounded up to a neat price.
prices.markupHint: Added to the NBU rate in every currency, USD included. 3 means 3 %.
prices.rulesHint: A price is rounded up to the next step plus the ending: step 10 and ending 9 give 1 289, 1 299 and so on. Prices below the optional threshold use the small step instead: step 1 and ending 0.90 give 29.90.
prices.exampleHint: Each currency below shows how this price looks with the values above.

errors.outOfRange: This value is out of range
errors.endingTooLarge: Must be less than the step
errors.smallTierIncomplete: Fill in all three small-price fields, or none

about.hint: Write your story in Ukrainian (required to publish) and in any other language. A language without its own text shows the English one, else the Ukrainian one; such a page is hidden from search engines.
about.editorHint: Headings, paragraphs, lists and links only; anything else is removed when you save.
about.metaDescriptionHint: Up to 500 characters. Left empty, the start of the text is used.
